capabilities: Show a floating toolbar above the current text selection
Convert selected lines between block types (headings, lists, callouts, code, math)
Apply text and highlight colors from Notion or Apple palettes
Toggle inline formatting such as bold, underline and links
Move a selection into a new note and leave a wikilink behind
disambiguation: Not a Notion integration; it only imitates Notion's selection toolbar inside Obsidian.
extras: Only manual installation is described (release files placed in the plugins folder). Text colors and some highlights are saved as HTML spans/mark tags that lose their color if the plugin is disabled; native ==highlight== syntax keeps working.
problem: Applying Markdown formatting and block conversions requires typing syntax or remembering commands, and Obsidian has no toolbar that appears over a selection.

relations.evidence: A Notion-style floating toolbar for Obsidian.
If the Notion-style Comments plugin is enabled, it opens that plugin's Add comment.

summary: Notion-style floating toolbar that appears on text selection to change block types, apply text and highlight colors, and toggle inline formatting.
